method: Static source/SHA256 comparison, Portable PDB source checksums and embedded generated source, played PE/PDB identity binding, frozen build settings and already-completed formal run evidence. No assemblies loaded for execution; no build, test or benchmark launched.

source_changes.change: Only accept validate/contracts in the operation allowlist and add a contracts-guarded ConstructionContracts.Run call after existing ValidateFixture and before existing Collect. Removing those two additions reproduces baseline source exactly.
New correctness-only helper, invoked exclusively by the guarded contracts branch; formal operation lists omit this branch.

Embedded generated script-type metadata includes the added ConstructionContracts file and its four types. Source checksums verified from both PDBs; this is engine script registration metadata, not a changed Measure body.

unchanged: Config parsing, Unity startup, fixtures, temporary file writes and semantic preflight are outside operation timing.
One unreported warmup precedes normal measurements; startup metric intentionally omits warmup.
Heavy samples force full GC before the timer. The stopwatch encloses only operation(); load_text operation is adapter.Load(sources).
Allocation sampling and GC-count collection surround the same operation. Result verification and retained-heap full GC follow elapsed capture.
Queries, dimensions, errors, preflight, output serialization and allocation probe bodies are unchanged.
timing_boundary.new_unmeasured_work: For formal groups, the additional groups.Contains("contracts") check evaluates false once before the existing full GC and measurement warmup. validate adds no timed branch; used alone it runs the already-unconditional preflight only.
timing_boundary.limit: Assembly-CSharp is not byte-identical: new helper code, registration metadata and method layout differ. Static audit establishes source-level fixture and timed-work equivalence, not identical JIT/code layout or a numerical bound on host overhead. Whole-player wall/peak metrics include engine and driver footprint. Final benefits still require complete paired rounds.

metadata.protocol: independent semantic preflight after optional startup; one warmup except startup; full GC before heavy samples; validation outside timing; OS cache retained; one fixture per process
metadata.memory: current-thread operation allocation or null if unsupported; GC counts for supported generations; Unity managed heap used/reserved; no OS process working set; retained delta is after validation/full GC for heavy metrics
